name: Sightbarrage
description: Warms the eye and the trigger hand with qi until the sights and the mark seem to rest on one line.

name: Glint Reticle
description: Times the trigger press to the empty gap between two heartbeats, when the body is at its stillest.

name: Hoarfrost Breath
description: Lets the tension drain from the forearms one breath before the shot so that no tremor reaches the barrel.

name: Verity Rearsight
description: Picks the officer or standard-bearer out of a moving crowd by watching which man the others glance toward.

name: Perceptive Scopemount
description: Gathers qi behind the eyes and locks the gaze on one spot of the target until the aim stays there unaided.

name: Grinding Chamber
description: Keeps qi even through the whole reload and the next aimed shot so accuracy does not sag as the arms tire.

name: Zeroassault
description: Aims at the join of two plates or the gap under a pauldron and lays qi in the shot to widen the opening.

name: Transfixing Nova Longshot
description: Gathers qi through a long motionless aim and then releases one shot whose ball keeps its line and its bite through a qi guard.

name: Unshaken Muzzlebrake
description: Knocks a thrown blade or arrow from the air with the barrel, qi stiffening both arms to turn its force aside.

name: Bolttorment
description: Cuts a narrow slot in the lip of a rifle pit and fires through it, offering the enemy almost no target.

name: Needling Bipod
description: Takes a loaded rifle from the man beside him and returns the empty one without lifting his eyes from the target.

name: Granite Magazine
description: Plants both elbows on a breastwork so that its mass takes the shock of every shot loosed against the position.

name: Meridian Rearsight
description: Watches a stretch of ground from behind a rail, marking each bush and shadow so that a change draws the eye at once.

name: Furrowing Sight
description: Returns the sights to the same fixed mark after every shot so the next needs no fresh aiming.

name: Harrowing Reticle
description: Holds one narrow lane before the position under steady aimed fire so that anything entering it is punished.

name: Enduring Chamber
description: Pours qi into legs and spine to keep the body rooted behind the parapet while heavy blows land against it.

name: Breaththrash
description: Drops the rifle low and sweeps butt and bayonet round the flank of the post to clear men vaulting the wall.

name: Scopebarrage
description: Sustains measured fire from behind the parapet, qi driving every reload and shot, until the enemy's advance stalls in front of it.

name: Interlocking Squeeze
description: Fires the final charge and in the same pull drives the bayonet through the smoke to meet the man rushing in.

name: Aura Reticle
description: Lets the qi field settle against the skin on a slow exhale before the sights are brought to the eye.

name: Nimbus Muzzlebrake
description: Reads the thin edge of the field where it brushes the muzzle to feel how true the rifle sits.

name: Nimbus Buttpad
description: Anchors the field at the shoulder where the stock sits so that recoil is shared by the whole body.

name: Sightleap
description: Rolls the hips as the field flows in the direction of travel, turning a stride into a long gliding pace.

name: Wrecking Scopemount
description: Lets the field wrap the leaving ball for its first paces to trim its yaw before the rifling carries it on.

name: Silencing Magazine
description: Thickens the powder smoke with qi so the field hides the shooter's outline from every eye but his own.

name: Aurazero
description: Draws a qi line from muzzle to target through the field so the ball follows it and slips through a gap in the guard.

name: Hamstringing Bolt
description: Sends a pulse of the field out of the muzzle beside the ball that breaks an enemy's focus as his technique forms.

name: Breathassault
description: Pauses the breath at the very bottom of an exhale and lets the sights drift onto the far mark.

name: Nimbus Squeeze
description: Rests the barrel on a branch fork or a roof beam and fires down from a perch the enemy does not search.

name: Discerning Rearsight
description: Watches the target's gait, glances and pauses until his next movement can be named before he makes it.

name: Flux Zero
description: Twists the sling into a tight loop about the upper arm to hold the rifle steady on a long aim.

name: Boltjaunt
description: Crawls backward from the firing place on elbows and toes, leaving the grass unflattened and the shooter unseen.

name: Zerothrash
description: Weighs the measure of powder in the palm before pouring it, so the long shot has exactly its due.

name: Ravaging Longshot
description: Keeps a thread of qi on the ball as it leaves, trimming its path across the full reach of the rifle.

name: Aura Scopemount
description: Sweeps a thread of qi around the edge of a wall to feel the warmth and motion of a man hidden behind it.

name: Murk Buttpad
description: Fires at the limit of the rifle's reach and is gone from the post before the enemy can find the smoke.

name: Scopetorment
description: Gathers qi in a deep field-steadied aim, then sends one shot to the far end of the rifle's reach that bores through a guard.

name: Lambasting Bolt
description: Drops long shots a pace ahead of every step the enemy tries to take, until he cannot advance or fall back.

name: Vessel Bipod
description: Sets the barrel on two rests, one beneath the forestock and one beneath the elbow, until the aim stills.

name: Waning Chamber
description: Fixes a hawk's unblinking gaze on one point of the target and ignores everything moving around it.

name: Sightthrash
description: Counts breaths aloud with a partner so that both rifles fire together on the last count.

name: Clear Rifling
description: Notes how a cloud's shadow crossing the field changes the light on the sights and adjusts the aim to match.

name: Splitting Buttpad
description: Lies in the lowest part of the basin where grass hides the body and the rim gives a natural rest for the elbows.

name: Skinning Zero
description: Fires along the length of a riverside rail, using the rail's line to carry the eye to the far end.

name: Scorching Rearsight
description: Runs one track of qi for aiming and another for loading so the hands work together without crossing purpose.

name: Nova Magazine
description: Fires downward from a height with qi in the shot so the ball strikes like a stooping hawk through a coat.

name: Trouncing Rifling
description: With a partner on the second rest, alternates shots at one point so two lines of fire pin the target.

name: Gust Chamber
description: Beats a thrust aside with the barrel and brings the stock back to the shoulder in the same motion, ready to fire.

name: Boltbarrage
description: Joins a partner's qi so two lines of fire cross at one point in the enemy ranks and hold it under pressure.

name: Needling Squeeze Onslaught
description: Holds the aiming track and the driving track of qi apart, then joins them in a single shot that bores through a guard.

name: Vessel Rifling
description: Rests the rifle on the rim of the basin where the ground rises, commanding every approach to the floor below.

name: Glint Magazine
description: Allows for the shimmer that rises off water and aims a shade low when firing at a far bank.

name: Remnant Bolt
description: Takes the bearing of two posts at once to know the angle at which a partner's line crosses one's own.

name: Bipodspurt
description: Moves one gap along the line each time the partner fires so that the pair's pattern is never fixed.

name: Grinding Longshot
description: Places shots so that they cross the lane of an enemy's advance from both sides, leaving no safe path.

name: Mayhem Cheekrest
description: Fires from a hollow so the report rolls round the basin and the enemy cannot tell which rim it came from.

name: Surging Buttpad
description: Exchanges places with a partner at a run, each passing through the other's line of cover without exposing a back.

name: Charter Magazine
description: Binds a lane of ground between two shooters' qi so that whatever crosses it meets crossing fire from both rifles.

name: Sightassault
description: Alternates firing and loading with a partner on one shared qi beat so the line is never silent.

name: Nimbus Chamber
description: Pairs one breath for the aim with a second for the shot, never letting the two overlap.

name: Verity Scopemount
description: Reads the clear high light of the Azure Sky and sets the sights for how sharp the front bead will look.

name: Bipodtorment
description: Settles onto a high perch and sits as motionless as a hawk before drawing the rifle to the cheek.

name: Mindful Bolt
description: Checks the rear leaf twice against a partner's call before the first shot of the day.

name: Breathcanter
description: Crawls along the lowest curve of the basin to a firing place that no sentry on the rim can see.

name: Nimbus Longshot
description: Holds the qi field around the body and a second thread along the barrel, steering the ball's first paces.

name: Reverie Muzzlebrake
description: Fires and slips back into low river mist, which the qi field thickens until the shooter's trail is lost.

name: Skinning Reticle
description: Sends a first shot wide to draw the enemy's glance, then a second onto the true mark.

name: Regal Longshot
description: Winds two tracks of qi together over a long aim and sends one shot that dives onto its mark and pierces a guard.

name: Scopecloak
description: Rolls the barrel into the path of a thrown spear on the second track of qi and turns it past the shooter's ear.

name: Chime Rearsight
description: Walks the bank and learns the width of the river at each bend by the size of reeds on the far side.

name: Torrent Cheekrest
description: Lies in a reed bed with the barrel resting on a clump of stems that sways with the real reeds.

name: Zeroleap
description: Crosses a ford from stone to stone with the rifle held high, never stepping where the water would splash.

name: Sightcanter
description: Slides down a wet bank on the belly with the lock held clear of the mud.

name: Raging Bolt
description: Leans out over a bridge rail to bring the barrel down onto a boat or the far bank.

name: Murk Scopemount
description: Reads the drift of leaves and mist above the water and sets the aim off by the push of the air.

name: Flux Reticle
description: Draws qi up two paths of the arm like two currents meeting, so the aim stays quiet while the shot gathers force.

name: Glamour Rearsight
description: Fires through the haze above the water so the enemy sees only a flash and a vague line of smoke.

name: Breathtorment
description: Keeps pace along the bank with a fleeing boat and sends shot after shot into its wake until it turns back.

name: Ironscope
description: Gathers qi in a held aim along the length of the river, then sends one shot down that line to pierce a guard.

name: Ravaging Chamber
description: Lays steady fire across the whole width of a ford so no one can cross it without being struck.
